video.title: The Ship That Brought Plague to Marseille | 1720

snippet.title: The Ship That Brought Plague to Marseille | 1720
snippet.description:
In 1720, the Grand Saint-Antoine reached Marseille after a voyage through the eastern Mediterranean. This film follows the ship’s return, the quarantine decisions at the port, the spread of plague through Marseille, and the ship’s final fate near the island of Jarre.

Chapters:
00:00 The ship approaches Marseille
00:50 Why quarantine mattered
01:56 The Grand Saint-Antoine’s voyage
02:47 The ship reaches Marseille
04:44 The outbreak spreads
05:46 Marseille under pressure
07:08 The ship is isolated near Jarre
07:48 The captain’s fate
08:10 The ship is remembered

Further reading:
Marseille History Museum — The 1720–1722 plague: https://musee-histoire.marseille.fr/node/2295
Marseille History Museum — Grand Saint-Antoine and the plague: https://musee-histoire.marseille.fr/index.php/node/2309
Marseille History Museum — Marseille during the epidemic: https://musee-histoire.marseille.fr/node/2306
Archives départementales des Bouches-du-Rhône — archival documents: https://www.archives13.fr/n/documents-a-dechiffrer/n%3A292
